summary: Peter Jeffris reported overdue from a Longs Peak summit attempt; body found November 20 about 200 feet below the Ledges on the Keyhole Route and flown out by helicopter
location: Longs Peak, Keyhole Route (below the Ledges), Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Rocky Mountain Rescue; Alpine Rescue Team; Diamond Peak Ski Patrol; Douglas County Search and Rescue; Search Dogs of Colorado; US Air Force Rescue Coordination Center
notes: Jeffris left Sunday morning Nov 16 to summit Longs Peak and was reported overdue the afternoon of Monday Nov 17 after failing to arrive at work; vehicle found at Longs Peak trailhead. He had told friends he was considering the Cables Route on the north face. Cause of death not stated in NPS release; winter conditions with extreme winds hampered the search. Body flown to Upper Beaver Meadows and transferred to the Boulder County Coroner. Alpine Rescue Team assisted Rocky Mountain National Park in the Longs Peak search 11/17–11/20 (Alpine 2014 annual mission summary, missions 14-121/122/123). Run 570: romo.htm compendium URL appended (parent-opened this run); corroborates the Cables Route / north-face / Keyhole Route search and the Boulder County coroner transfer. SARDOC Q4-2014 public mission summaries: SARDOC dog team plus a SAR member and an RMNP ranger searched at/above 10,000 ft to treeline for 3.5 hours on 2014-11-19 in severe winter conditions (sub-freezing, 60+ mph winds); body spotted next day by helicopter crew and recovered by rangers.
